summary: Comprehensive testing of Admin Accounting feature for AppCloud by Optio. Backend: 22/22 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All UI components and interactions working correctly. Commission approval workflow, payout processing, bulk actions, and filtering all functional.

backend: Dashboard returns commission and payout stats with correct structure
Seed demo data creates commissions and payouts
List commissions with status filter works correctly
Commission has correct structure (id, user_id, type, amount, status)
Node sale commission amount is $250 (5% of $5000)
Mark commission as paid changes status to 'paid'
List payouts with status filter works correctly
Payout has correct structure with earnings_breakdown
Complete payout (mark as paid) works correctly
frontend: Admin login and navigation to /admin/accounting works
Accounting page loads with dashboard stats (Pending Commissions, Approved Awaiting Pay, Pending App Payouts, Paid This Month)
Commissions tab shows node sale commissions with $250 amount and 'Node Sale (5%)' label
App Earnings tab shows payout requests with app breakdown (DataVault Pro, StreamRelay, ChainBridge, OneTask)
Status filter dropdown works (All Status, Pending, Approved, Processing, Paid, Rejected)
Search by user input field is present
Approve button opens confirmation dialog with user email and amount
Reject button opens dialog with rejection reason textarea
Mark Paid button works and shows success toast
Bulk action bar appears when items selected ('X commission(s) selected')
Approve All button opens bulk approve dialog
Reject All button opens bulk reject dialog
Seed Demo Data button is visible and accessible

critical_code_review_comments: Backend accounting API endpoints are well-structured with proper authentication
Commission calculation is correct: 5% of $5000 = $250 per node sale referral
Frontend properly uses localStorage.getItem('admin_token') for auth
data-testid attributes present on navigation items (admin-nav-accounting)
Status badges have appropriate colors for different states
Bulk actions properly handle success/failure counts
Audit logging is implemented for commission and payout actions
seed_data_creation: Used 'Seed Demo Data' button to generate test commissions and payouts. Demo data includes node_sale commissions ($250 each) and app_earnings payouts with variable amounts.

mocked_data.note: No mocked APIs - all data is real from MongoDB

context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Accounting feature fully tested and working. Backend has 22 passing tests covering all CRUD operations, actions (approve/reject/pay), and bulk operations. Frontend UI tested with Playwright - all buttons clickable, dialogs open correctly, status filters work, bulk selection works. Test credentials: admin@optio.com/admin123. Commission amount is $250 (5% of $5000 node price).
